about.bio:
I am a Computer Science student and a former U.S. Army Interpreter dedicated to solving complex problems, whether they are coded in Python or spoken in the field. My unique background combines the high-stakes discipline of military operations with the analytical rigor of software engineering.

I view coding and linguistics as two sides of the same coin: both require breaking down complex, high-context systems into structured, logical syntax to bridge gaps and drive mission success. I focus on backend architecture, database integrity, and efficient algorithms.

Maintaining a 3.3 GPA alongside my academic and technical coursework. Skilled in C++, Python, SQL, and web development technologies, eager to contribute to dynamic teams and create impactful software applications.

Armed with a zero-fail military mindset and robust technical training, I apply rigorous quality assurance standards to every codebase I write. I am actively preparing for technical placement roles in full stack and backend software engineering.

summary: Proficient in procedural programming, memory mechanics, and structural basics. Skilled in Object-oriented programming architectures, manual & automated memory management, and modern standards.
items: 🔵 C++ Application Development (Fundamentals)

• Syntax & Logic:

Proficient in structural logic, multi-conditional branching, loops, and functional decomposition.

• Procedural Mastery:

Experienced in building menu-driven console applications, automated data processing scripts, and interactive math/logic programs.

• Foundational OOP:

Able to model real-world concepts into simple classes, ensuring clean code separation using basic encapsulation rules.

• Standard Library:

Skilled in basic console input/output parsing (``) and fixed data collection using basic arrays.
🔵 C++ Application Development (Graphical User Interface)

• Object-Oriented Architecture:

Designed and built multi-class inheritance hierarchies implementing runtime polymorphism, virtual functions, and abstract interfaces.

• Memory & Resource Management:

Strong grasp of memory life cycles, stack vs. heap allocation, reference passing, and preventing manual memory leaks using dynamic allocation.

• Data Structures & STL:

Leveraging STL containers (`std::vector`, `std::map`, `std::list`) alongside algorithm libraries to optimize runtime performance.

• Modular Software Engineering:

Adept at splitting application logic into distinct headers (`.h`) and implementation (`.cpp`) files, building robust error-handling pipelines with exceptions, and handling persistent storage using custom File I/O interfaces.

summary: Building lightweight web servers, handling HTTP protocols, serving dynamic templates, designing database schemas and integrating persistent relational storage engines into Python apps as well as Packaging applications securely and launching them onto cloud ecosystems.
items: 🔵 Python Foundations:

• Data Control:

Implementing conditional logic (if/elif/else) and loops (for, while, break/continue).

• Data Structures:

Efficient use of Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples, and Sets for basic data storage.

• Clean Code:

Structuring logic into reusable, modular functions with clear parameters and return types.

• File Handling:

Reading from and writing to local .txt and .csv files using context managers (with open).
🔵 Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) Basics:

• Class Architecture:

Creating classes, defining attributes inside __init__, and implementing instance methods.

• Inheritance

Extending base classes to eliminate redundant code.

• Encapsulation:

Using public and private/protected attributes appropriately to shield internal data.
🔵 Error Handling & Debugging:

• Defensive Coding:

Implementing try/except/finally blocks to intercept common errors (e.g., ValueError, KeyError, FileNotFoundError).

• Debugging:

Navigating tracebacks, using print-statement logging, or inspecting variables via basic IDE debuggers.
🔵 Dynamic Web Backends (Flask/FastAPI):

• Schema Design:

Designing structured SQL tables with primary keys, foreign keys, and logical relationships.

• Database Control:

Utilizing sqlite3 or an ORM (like SQLAlchemy) to execute secure CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete).

• File Upload Integration:

Safely storing, mapping, and retrieving media assets (like local image paths) from a database structure.
🔵 Architecture, Environment & Deployment:

• Environment Isolation:

Managing clean project structures using virtual environments (venv) and compiling requirements.txt.

• Security Configuration:

Isolating runtime variables and sensitive keys outside code repositories using .env files.

• Cloud Deployment:

Preparing WSGI/ASGI application configs to deploy live code to production cloud hosts (e.g., Render, Vercel).
